the_question: of the 28 mined tasks, which ones could the current operator family possibly reach, and does it reach them?

the_ceiling_subset.rule: the real fix changes at most 4 source lines and adds no function: the only shape a substitution-family operator could express

what_the_six_actually_are.2aada00b: a regex quantifier [^\s;)]* changed to + in specifiers.py -- one character
what_the_six_actually_are.2602dd07: a regex [^ \t]+ changed to \S+ in _tokenizer.py -- one character class
what_the_six_actually_are.8c37b047: add a two-line guard early in a function that raises InvalidLicenseExpression
what_the_six_actually_are.8efde605: bind an include_group variable one line above its use
what_the_six_actually_are.b1c439b0: replace cls.__dict__ with Metadata.__dict__ in two places
what_the_six_actually_are.d17cfaf0: add a three-line early return in a function

why_zero: the operator family is keyed to exceptions named in the traceback; five of these six produce no source frame at all
the fixes are REGEX CHARACTER changes and early-return guards. Neither is a substitution of an expression that already exists, which is the only grammar the operators have

one operator (WRAP_EXCEPTION) fires on the three did-not-raise tasks, but it wraps a statement in a try/except where the real fix tightens a regex or adds a guard. The mechanism is expressible; the edit is in the wrong place and of the wrong kind

the_error_i_corrected_this_round.claim: 4 tasks need only dunder methods, which are formulaic
the_error_i_corrected_this_round.reality: __getstate__ (46 lines), __replace__ (55 lines) and __init__ rewrites are API redesigns, not formulas
the_error_i_corrected_this_round.correction: classifying by syntax (dunder vs plain) instead of by difficulty. Ninth comparator-of-convenience in this project.

the_honest_reading: the operators solve 0 of 6 tasks whose fixes are ONE TO FOUR LINES. That is not a localisation problem, not a small-sample problem, and not a search-budget problem. The family is keyed to exception types and to substituting expressions that already exist; real fixes are regex character changes, early-return guards, and attribute rebindings at a site nothing points to.
what_this_is_not: a benchmark result and not a capability claim. Six tasks in one repository. No benchmark row exists or is claimed.
